pages.title: touch
pages.blurb: A strip per note. Press anywhere to sound it, slide up for louder, use as many fingers as you have.

pages.title: imu
pages.blurb: A drone that never stops. Tilt, turn and shake the phone to play it.

pages.title: droplet
pages.blurb: Synth droplets, ported from AirKit. Hold the phone flat to play, stand it upright to stop.

pages.title: melchair
pages.blurb: AirKit's melChair3. Turn the phone to play a figure on a self-feeding sine.

pages.title: suz
pages.blurb: AirKit's suz1. Nine notes against a sixteen-step octave, drifting apart.

pages.title: beast
pages.blurb: AirKit's movingBeast. Five against four against seven. Shake, turn, tilt and roll.

pages.title: scsynth tester
pages.blurb: Boot the engine, play any SynthDef from the library, and watch the OSC traffic and audio thread while it runs.

pages.title: scratch
pages.blurb: A throwaway page. It exists to prove that adding one costs a directory and a line here, with no DNS record and no certificate.
